Summary: Prepare interview guide and consent form
Description: As a researcher I want an interview guide and consent form so that I collect research data ethically

Summary: Run interviews with students wardens and admin staff
Description: As a researcher I want to interview real users so that I understand their problems

Summary: Run the resident survey
Description: As a researcher I want survey data so that I can measure how common the problems are

Summary: Build personas and empathy maps from real findings
Description: As a researcher I want personas based on evidence so that the team shares one view of users

Summary: Write problem statements and How Might We questions
Description: As a researcher I want focused HMW questions so that ideation has direction

Summary: Scan the hostel QR code then register or sign in
Description: As a student I want to scan my hostel's QR code and land only on my hostel so that my complaints reach the right warden

Summary: Raise a complaint with category location description and photos
Description: As a student I want to report a problem quickly so that it gets fixed

Summary: Mark a complaint confidential
Description: As a student I want sensitive complaints hidden from everyone except the owner warden so that my privacy is protected

Summary: Track complaint status with a timeline
Description: As a student I want to see progress so that I know someone is acting

Summary: Confirm fix and rate the resolution
Description: As a student I want to confirm the fix and rate it so that quality is measured

Summary: Reopen a complaint that is not fixed
Description: As a student I want to reopen a complaint so that unresolved problems are not lost

Summary: Receive in-app notifications
Description: As a student I want alerts when status changes so that I do not need to chase

Summary: See a priority and age sorted queue with overdue first
Description: As a warden I want urgent and late complaints first so that nothing is ignored

Summary: Filter and search complaints
Description: As a warden I want filters by status category block and priority so that I find items fast

Summary: Assign maintenance staff
Description: As a warden I want to assign a person so that responsibility is clear

Summary: Update status with notes
Description: As a warden I want to move a complaint through the workflow so that students see progress

Summary: Add internal notes hidden from students
Description: As a warden I want private notes so that I can coordinate

Summary: Keep a directory of nearby service providers
Description: As a warden I want plumbers electricians and others with their mobile numbers so that I can assign and call them quickly

Summary: Manage my hostel's complaint categories and target times
Description: As a warden I want to set categories and target hours so that overdue is meaningful

Summary: Manage the people of my hostel
Description: As a warden I want to disable accounts reset student passwords and add assistant wardens so that access is controlled

Summary: View analytics of my hostel from real data
Description: As a warden I want counts resolution time and ratings so that I can make decisions

Summary: Export my hostel's complaints to CSV
Description: As a warden I want a CSV export so that I can report outside the system

Summary: Protect against CSRF and brute-force login
Description: As the owner I want the system protected so that accounts are safe

Summary: Validate and restrict uploads
Description: As the owner I want only real images accepted so that the server stays safe

Summary: Write automated service and HTTP tests
Description: As a developer I want repeatable tests so that changes do not break rules

Summary: Plan and run task-based usability tests
Description: As a tester I want to watch real users complete tasks so that I find design problems

Summary: Collect SUS questionnaire responses
Description: As a tester I want standard satisfaction scores so that usability is measured

Summary: Apply test findings
Description: As a designer I want to fix issues found in testing so that the design improves

Summary: Write the final report
Description: As the author I want a complete report so that I can submit the project

Summary: Prepare the presentation and demo
Description: As the author I want a clear demo so that the work is understood

Summary: Warden submits a hostel registration request
Description: As a warden I want to register my hostel with my details so that it can join the platform

Summary: Confirm the warden email before the request counts
Description: As the platform owner I want the email verified so that fake or mistyped requests never reach me

Summary: Administrator accepts or rejects from an email link or the dashboard
Description: As the platform administrator I want an email with only Accept and Reject so that I can decide quickly

Summary: Approved warden receives a one-time setup link
Description: As a warden I want a link to set my password and open my hostel dashboard so that I can configure my hostel

Summary: Warden designs the complaint form with dropdowns and text fields
Description: As a warden I want to choose what students are asked so that complaints arrive with the details I need

Summary: Publish the hostel and get a printable QR code
Description: As a warden I want a QR code so that students reach my hostel's complaint page directly

Summary: Isolate every hostel's data from all others
Description: As the platform owner I want no hostel to see another's complaints people or settings so that privacy is guaranteed

Summary: Send confirmation and approval emails through Gmail SMTP
Description: As the platform owner I want free reliable email with retries and a log so that nobody misses a link

Summary: Suspend and reactivate a hostel
Description: As the platform administrator I want to block a hostel without deleting its data so that misuse can be stopped

Summary: Regenerate the QR code
Description: As a warden I want to replace a leaked QR code so that old printed codes stop working
